name: FPV Drone Warfare
desc:
Welcome to FPV Drone Warfare!
An intense, large-scale battlefield where every second counts. Fight through chaotic frontlines, secure strategic objectives, and work with your squad to dominate the warzone.

Pick your loadout, adapt to the environment, and outsmart the enemy in a relentless struggle for survival. Team coordination, positioning, and smart decisions will determine victory or defeat.

⚠️ This game is still in development. Expect bugs, missing features, and frequent updates as Drone Warfare evolves with new content.

🔴 Exploiters will be permanently banned.

Like and favorite the game to stay updated on new content!
